rules.statement: The Ceylon State Mortgage Bank is not liable to pay damages suffered by a debtor in consequence of parate execution levied by it, under section 63 of the Ceylon State Mortgage Bank Ordinance, against the property mortgaged to it by the debtor.
rules.supporting_quote: "Unless it has exercised its powers negligently, the Ceylon State Mortgage Bank is not liable to pay damages suffered by a debtor in consequence of parate execution levied by it, under section 63 of the Ceylon State Mortgage Bank Ordinance, against the property mortgaged to it by the debtor."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 63 of the Ceylon State Mortgage Bank Ordinance

meta.parties: Mendis Silva v. The Ceylon State Mortgage Bank
